summary: The bad() method parses an external value (System.getProperty("user.home")) into numberOfLoops and uses it directly as an unbounded loop condition (CWE-606: Unchecked Input for Loop Condition). An attacker-controlled property could cause an excessively large or negative loop count, leading to resource exhaustion. The fix validates the parsed value against a sane range after parsing, resetting it to a safe default when out of bounds, while leaving legitimate small values working unchanged.
